# Advance Physiotherapy Centre

> Advance Physiotherapy Centre is a premier evidence-based physiotherapy, pain management, and physical rehabilitation clinic in Muzaffarpur, Bihar, operating across 2 clinic locations (Juran Chapra Main Clinic & New Zero Mile Branch), led by Dr. Shahrukh Firoz (B.P.T., M.P.T., Ortho).

Advance Physiotherapy Centre offers clinical assessments, non-surgical spine and joint care, specialized electrotherapy, cupping therapy (dry, wet/Hijama, fire cupping), dry needling, chiropractic adjustments, osteopathy, and personalized home visit services across Muzaffarpur.

## Core Specializations & Services

- [Spine & Back Pain Rehabilitation](https://www.advancephysiotherapycentre.in/services/spine-back-pain): Evidence-based therapy for disc herniation/slip disc, sciatica, chronic lower back spasms, lumbar spondylosis, and postural strains.
- [Cervical & Neck Pain Care](https://www.advancephysiotherapycentre.in/services/cervical-neck-care): Relieving cervical spondylosis, tech-neck tension, trapped nerves, radiating arm numbness, and cervicogenic headaches.
- [Knee Pain & Joint Arthritis](https://www.advancephysiotherapycentre.in/services/knee-joint-arthritis): Joint preservation and mobility programs for osteoarthritis, ligament sprains (ACL/MCL), meniscus recovery, and post-TKR (Total Knee Replacement) rehab.
- [Frozen Shoulder Mobilization](https://www.advancephysiotherapycentre.in/services/frozen-shoulder): 3-stage protocol for adhesive capsulitis, rotator cuff injuries, and shoulder impingement to restore full overhead range of motion without surgery.
- [Advanced Electrotherapy](https://www.advancephysiotherapycentre.in/services/electrotherapy): Modalities including Interferential Therapy (IFT), TENS, Therapeutic Ultrasound, and Muscle Stimulators for accelerated cellular healing and acute pain modulation.
- [Sports Injury Rehabilitation](https://www.advancephysiotherapycentre.in/services/sports-rehabilitation): Biomechanical movement analysis, sports-specific conditioning, tendon rehabilitation, and Kinesiology taping for athletes and active individuals.
- [Neurological Rehabilitation](https://www.advancephysiotherapycentre.in/services/neurological-rehabilitation): Neuro-developmental therapy and gait re-training for stroke recovery (hemiplegia), facial palsy (Bell's palsy), Parkinson's disease, and neuropathy.
- [Posture Correction & Workplace Ergonomics](https://www.advancephysiotherapycentre.in/services/posture-ergonomics): Spinal alignment assessments, ergonomic workplace setup counseling, and core stabilizer muscle strengthening.
- [Women's Health & Pelvic Floor Physiotherapy](https://www.advancephysiotherapycentre.in/services/womens-health): Antenatal and postnatal exercise protocols, diastasis recti recovery, and pelvic floor muscle training.
- [Pediatric & ICU Bedside Care](https://www.advancephysiotherapycentre.in/services/pediatric-icu-care): Chest physiotherapy, ICU mobility protocols, and developmental rehabilitation for cerebral palsy and congenital conditions.
- [Home Visit Physiotherapy Service](https://www.advancephysiotherapycentre.in/services): Personalized bedside physiotherapy at home across Muzaffarpur for elderly, bedridden, post-operative, or mobility-impaired patients.

## Specialized Treatment Modalities Available

- **Dry Cupping Therapy**: Targeted negative-pressure myofascial release to enhance capillary microcirculation and dissolve stubborn muscle knots.
- **Wet Cupping (Hijama)**: Clinical sterile Hijama therapy for deep tissue detox, systemic inflammation reduction, and chronic pain alleviation.
- **Fire Cupping**: Traditional heated glass cups for deep muscle relaxation and stubborn back/shoulder spasms.
- **Dry Needling**: Intramuscular stimulation using sterile filiform needles to directly deactivate myofascial trigger points.
- **Chiropractic & Osteopathy**: Gentle joint realignment, manual spinal mobilization, and decompression techniques.
- **Kinesiology Taping**: Elastic neuromuscular taping for joint stability, edema reduction, and neuromuscular facilitation.

## Patient Recovery Pathway (4 Steps)

1. **Clinical Assessment & Diagnosis**: Comprehensive evaluation of posture, range of motion, nerve conduction, and pain triggers.
2. **Immediate Pain Relief**: Targeted gentle manual therapy, electrotherapy, or dry needling to bring rapid symptom control.
3. **Mobility & Strength Restoration**: Progressive therapeutic exercises, spinal decompression, and joint stabilization.
4. **Maintenance & Prevention**: Custom home-exercise program and lifestyle ergonomic guidelines to prevent future recurrence.
